definitions.explanation: Cables used to transmit electrical power over long distances.

examples.japanese: {架空|かくう}{送電線|そうでんせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{点検|てんけん}→点検：09765_tenken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: To conduct an inspection of overhead power lines.

examples.japanese: {送電線|そうでんせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{切|き}れた。
{高圧|こうあつ}{送電線|そうでんせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{近|ちか}づかないで⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please don't go near the high-voltage power lines.

notes:
{送電線|そうでんせん} refers to power transmission cables.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {架空|かくう}{送電線|そうでんせん}: overhead power line
- {高圧|こうあつ}{送電線|そうでんせん}: high-voltage power line
- {送電線|そうでんせん}{鉄塔|てっとう}: transmission tower

RELATED WORDS:
- {電線|でんせん}: electric wire, power line (general term)
- {配電|はいでん}: power distribution
- {送電|そうでん}: power transmission
